name: fastf1-mcp-server

tools.name: get_schedule

Coverage: 1950-present

tools.name: get_driver_standings

Get driver championship standings.

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)
Coverage: 1950-present

tools.name: get_constructor_standings
tools.description:
Get constructor championship standings.

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)
Coverage: 1958-present (constructor championship started 1958)

tools.name: get_driver_info
tools.description:
Get driver information.

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)
Coverage: 1950-present

driver_id.description:
Ergast driver ID (e.g., "max_verstappen", "hamilton")
       If None, returns all drivers

year.description: Filter to drivers who raced in this season

tools.name: get_race_results_historical
tools.description:
Get historical race results (pre-2018 or when session data unavailable).

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)
Coverage: 1950-present

tools.name: get_circuit_info
tools.description:
Get circuit information.

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)

circuit_id.description:
Ergast circuit ID (e.g., "monaco", "silverstone")
        If None, returns all circuits

year.description: Filter to circuits used in this season

tools.name: get_session_results
tools.description:
Get session classification/results.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

session.description: Session type — R, Q, S, SQ, FP1, FP2, FP3

tools.name: get_lap_times
tools.description:
Get all lap times for a driver in a session.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

Set `export_path=True` when the user mentions data analysis, notebooks,
pandas, ML, "save as CSV", "export the data", or any downstream
processing — the full per-lap array is then written to a CSV file the
user can open directly. Large responses (>50 laps) also auto-export so
the user always gets a real file path in the project rather than the
MCP client silently spilling the response to a temp file.

session.description: Session type (R, Q, S, FP1, FP2, FP3)

export_path.description:
If True, write the full per-lap array to a CSV in the
         configured export directory (default `./fastf1-exports/`,
         override via FASTF1_MCP_EXPORT_DIR) and omit `laps` from
         the response. Pass a string for a custom directory or
         `.csv` file path. The server also auto-exports when
         the lap count exceeds FASTF1_MCP_AUTO_EXPORT_ROWS
         (default 50).

tools.name: get_fastest_laps
tools.description:
Get fastest laps in a session, one per driver.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

top_n.description: Number of fastest laps to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_race_pace
tools.description:
Calculate average race pace for all drivers.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

exclude_first_laps.description: Number of opening laps to exclude (default 2)

exclude_sc_laps.description: Exclude laps behind safety car or VSC (default True)

min_laps.description: Minimum valid laps required to include a driver (default 10)

tools.name: get_stint_analysis
tools.description:
Analyze tire stints for a race.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

Set `export_path=True` when the user mentions data analysis, notebooks,
pandas, ML, "save as CSV", "export the strategy data", or any downstream
processing — the full per-stint array is written to CSV. Large
responses (>50 stints, typical for full-grid races) also auto-export.

driver.description: Optional driver code to filter (default: all drivers)

export_path.description:
If True, write the full per-stint array to a CSV in
         the configured export directory (default
         `./fastf1-exports/`, override via FASTF1_MCP_EXPORT_DIR)
         and omit `stints` from the response. Pass a string for
         a custom directory or `.csv` file path. The server
         also auto-exports when the stint count exceeds
         FASTF1_MCP_AUTO_EXPORT_ROWS (default 50).

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

tools.name: get_qualifying_breakdown
tools.description:
Get qualifying results split by Q1/Q2/Q3.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

tools.name: list_events
tools.description:
List all events in a season.

Data source: Ergast API (via FastF1)
Coverage: 1950-present

tools.name: list_drivers
tools.description:
List all drivers in a season, optionally filtered to a specific event.

Data source: Ergast API (season list) or FastF1 session (event filter)

event.description:
Optional race name or round number to filter by event
   (returns only drivers who participated in that session)

tools.name: get_cache_status
tools.description:
Check server in-memory session cache status.

Returns:
    {
        "sessions_cached": 3,
        "max_sessions": 10,
        "cached_sessions": [
            {"year": 2024, "event": "Monaco", "session": "R",
             "loaded_at": "2024-05-26T14:00:00"},
            ...
        ],
        "fastf1_cache_path": "~/.fastf1_cache",
        "fastf1_cache_size_mb": 1234.5
    }

Example:
    get_cache_status() → {"sessions_cached": 2, "max_sessions": 10, ...}

Note:
    Reports in-memory LRU cache only. The FastF1 disk cache
    (used for raw timing data) is reported separately as size_mb.

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear cached sessions from in-memory storage.

year.description: Optional year filter — only clear sessions for this year

event.description: Optional event filter — requires year to be set

tools.name: get_lap_telemetry
tools.description:
Get telemetry data for a specific lap.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

Set `export_path=True` when the user mentions data analysis, notebooks,
pandas, ML, "plot the telemetry", "save the trace", or downstream
processing — the sampled per-distance trace is written to CSV.
Telemetry responses with the default 200 sample points also auto-export
so the user always gets a real file path in the project.

session.description: Session type (R, Q, S, FP1, FP2, FP3)

sample_size.description: Number of telemetry points to return (default 200, max 500)

export_path.description:
If True, write the sampled `data` array to a CSV in
         the configured export directory (default
         `./fastf1-exports/`, override via FASTF1_MCP_EXPORT_DIR)
         and omit `data` from the response. Pass a string for a
         custom directory or `.csv` file path. The server also
         auto-exports when `data` would exceed
         FASTF1_MCP_AUTO_EXPORT_ROWS rows (default 50). Use a
         larger sample_size if you want more detail in the
         exported file.

tools.name: compare_telemetry
tools.description:
Compare telemetry between two drivers on the same session.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

Set `export_path=True` when the user wants the comparison data for
analysis (notebook, pandas, ML, "plot where one driver gains time",
"save the comparison"). Comparisons at the default 200 sample size
also auto-export.

session.description: Session type (R, Q, S, FP1, FP2, FP3)

lap.description: Lap number or "fastest" — applied independently to each driver

export_path.description:
If True, write the per-distance `comparison` array to
         a CSV in the configured export directory (default
         `./fastf1-exports/`, override via FASTF1_MCP_EXPORT_DIR)
         and omit `comparison` from the response. Pass a string
         for a custom directory or `.csv` file path.

tools.name: get_speed_trap_data
tools.description:
Get speed trap and top-speed data for all drivers in a session.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing (session results)
Coverage: 2018-present

session.description: Session type (R, Q, S, FP1, FP2, FP3)

tools.name: get_sector_times
tools.description:
Get best sector times and theoretical best lap for each driver.

Data source: FastF1 Live Timing
Coverage: 2018-present

Set `include_laps=True` when the user wants per-lap sector breakdowns
(e.g. "show me Antonelli's sector times each lap") rather than just
the per-driver best/theoretical-best summary.

session.description: Session type (R, Q, S, FP1, FP2, FP3)

driver.description: Optional driver code to filter (default: all drivers)

include_laps.description:
If True, include a `laps` array per driver with each
          accurate lap's S1/S2/S3 and total lap time. Default
          False keeps responses compact for the typical
          "fastest sectors / theoretical best" question.
